159: /// Takes initial turn input and runs a loop where, at each sampling request,
160: /// the model replies with either:
161: ///
162: /// - requested function calls
163: /// - an assistant message
164: ///
165: /// While it is possible for the model to return multiple of these items in a
166: /// single sampling request, in practice, we generally one item per sampling request:
167: ///
168: /// - If the model requests a function call, we execute it and send the output
169: ///   back to the model in the next sampling request.
170: /// - If the model sends only an assistant message, we record it in the
171: ///   conversation history and consider the turn complete.
172: ///
173: pub(crate) async fn run_turn(
174:     sess: Arc<Session>,
175:     turn_context: Arc<TurnContext>,
176:     mut input: Vec<TurnInput>,
177:     mcp_startup_requirements: &mut McpStartupRequirements,
178:     prewarmed_client_session: Option<ModelClientSession>,
179:     cancellation_token: CancellationToken,
180: ) -> CodexResult<Option<String>> {
181:     let auto_compaction_enabled = sess
182:         .services
183:         .thread_extension_data
184:         .get::<AutoCompactionDisabled>()
185:         .is_none();
186:     let auto_summarization_enabled =
187:         auto_compaction_enabled && !turn_context.config.features.enabled(Feature::TokenBudget);
188:     if crate::guardian::is_basic_session_source(&turn_context.session_source) {
189:         crate::guardian::check_pending_guardian_input(&sess, &turn_context).await?;
190:     }
191:     // Record results from hooks that finished after the previous turn before this turn's user prompt.
192:     drain_async_hook_results(&sess, &turn_context, /*before_user_prompt*/ true).await;
193: 
194:     let mut client_session =
195:         prewarmed_client_session.unwrap_or_else(|| sess.services.model_client.new_session());
